questions.question: Why did Jesus say the crowd crossed the sea to Capernaum to look for Him?

answers.text: They had eaten the loaves and had their fill
They had seen Him walking on the sea
They wanted Him to heal their sick

questions.question: What did Jesus tell a crowd in Capernaum is the work of God?

answers.text: To believe in the One He has sent
To keep every command of the law
To give to everyone in need

questions.question: Jesus told the crowd that Moses was the one who gave them the true bread from heaven. True or false?
